international.title: Thousands still without power after storms that snarled Thanksgiving travel
international.summary: Heavy rains and high winds downed trees and power lines and led to water rescues from New York to Virginia Skies cleared along the US eastern seaboard on Friday, and power was being restored to hundreds of thousands of customers whose Thanksgiving plans were disrupted by heavy rains and high winds that swept over the region a day earlier. The storms snarled travel, downed trees and power lines and led to water rescues from New York to Virginia. At its peak, nearly a million customers were without power . Continue reading...
